title: Once plans can run out, a gym whose plan has ended keeps its look for members but cannot change it, and is told only 'That didn't save'
what: The plan lock is built but switched off today. Once it is on, a gym whose free trial or paid plan ran out more than 7 days ago loses the Pro extras, and the logo and colours are one of them. But the look stays where it is: the server keeps sending it, and the member app checks only the gym's pack, not whether the plan has run out, so members keep the gym's logo and colours. The Branding page also checks only the pack, so it stays open. Every Save is refused, and Branding shows 'That didn't save. Please try again.' It never says the plan has run out or how to pay. The admin app already has the right words for this refusal, but Branding does not use them.
expected: The rule is the same in all three places. Either a gym whose plan has ended keeps its look and can still change it, or the look goes back to MettleUp's for members, the web page and the header together, and Branding says the plan has run out and points to Pay MettleUp.
how_often: every gym whose plan ends, once the plan lock is switched on
fix_line: Pick one rule for a gym whose plan has ended, apply it in the server, member app and Branding page, and show the plan words on a refused save

items.reason: Web panel: no install package, sideload, watch or phone version split here. The service worker fetches from the network first and drops old files; a saved copy from another version is thrown away and fetched again; each new logo gets a new file name, so the 1-year cache never shows an old logo. Open tab: same no-reload-notice fault as FN-B-time-panel-assistant-01; old open Branding screen overwrite already FN-B-truth-panel-brand-shell-a-01. Which member app versions are still in use: unknown (needs Play data).

Plan end / trial end: FN-B-time-panel-brand-shell-01 (lock switched off today). Saved date has no year at year end: FN-B-truth-panel-brand-shell-b-02. Replaced logos kept for ever: FN-L14-panel-brand-shell-03. Staff leaving, owner changing phone, leap day: Branding keeps no dates or people of its own; only the owner role opens it. Member leaves and returns: the look follows the member's gym link on the phone.

Two flows came later. Suggesting a colour from the logo also reads a logo saved before it existed. Taking the plain box off runs only on a new upload, so a logo saved before 15 Nov 2026 keeps its box.
Path exists: the 15 Nov What's new line tells existing owners that uploading the logo again takes the box off, with an Open Branding button; Change logo runs the same check.
A path exists, so no finding.
A browser meeting its first update only remembers it; the New dots skip updates older than the gym's join day and pages not on the person's menu.
No new marks on old things for a brand-new gym or browser.
